population.missing_archip_action: exclude from primary without replacement; retain only as descriptive sensitivity after primary is complete

regional_pool.purpose: broad response-independent pool for species_x_regional_pool R3 control, distinct from heldout archipelago blocks
regional_pool.geometry: archipelago centroid assigned to fixed global latitude-longitude cells
regional_pool.archipelago_centroid_latitude: arithmetic mean latitude across matched islands in the archipelago
regional_pool.archipelago_centroid_longitude: circular mean longitude across matched islands in the archipelago
regional_pool.sparse_pool_rule: for each candidate width, exclude regional pools containing fewer than 3 islands before evaluating the width
regional_pool.width_selection: choose the smallest candidate width retaining at least 98% of archip-known islands after sparse-pool exclusion and for which one mandatory pilot archipelago per retained regional pool contains at most 20% of retained islands

validation_blocks.reason: whole archipelagos are held out so nearby islands within an archipelago cannot leak occurrence/source information across validation boundaries
validation_blocks.mandatory_pilot: within every retained regional pool choose the SHA256-lowest archipelago under salt|archip
validation_blocks.additional_pilot: rank all remaining archipelagos by SHA256(salt|archip), add a prefix and select the prefix whose island count is closest to 20% of retained islands while leaving at least 30 confirmatory archipelagos

state_reference.gmmc_semantics: Last Glacial Maximum mainland-connection / historical-connection proxy; not a complete geological-origin classification
state_reference.standardization: population mean and population SD across the exact 503-island primary population

generic_network_R2.distance: haversine great-circle kilometers using frozen GIFT centroids
generic_network_R2.k_selection: within each regional pool separately choose the smallest k in 1..n-1 whose symmetrized kNN graph is connected
generic_network_R2.edge_decay_scale: within-regional-pool median unique selected edge length

future_species_conditioned_reference.regional_prevalence_smoothing: Jeffreys add-0.5/add-1 binomial smoothing within the fixed 60-degree regional pool
future_species_conditioned_reference.pilot_training_rows: leave the entire target pilot archipelago out of every species-conditioned source feature
future_species_conditioned_reference.confirmatory_rows: use only the complete retained pilot response as species source support; no confirmatory occurrence enters any feature

primary_estimand.within_block: mean binary log-loss difference loss_C - loss_R3 over eligible island-by-species targets in each confirmatory archipelago
primary_estimand.across_blocks: equal-weight mean of confirmatory archipelago means
primary_estimand.support: point estimate <0 and 95% bootstrap upper bound <0

geological_origin_gate.do_not_substitute: gmmc may not be relabelled geological origin
